evidence.detail: times_from_timezone_code returns ALL pytz.common_timezones matching the code, grouped by current time; for EST this is ~24 entries
command joins all extracted city names with ', ' and sends a single message; no truncation

bakert comment: 'difficult to programmatically account for it and get the right output … we definitely don't want to arbitrarily truncate. New York is the right output I suppose.' CET maps to 28 cities.

triage.notes: The owner's comment shows genuine ambiguity: arbitrary truncation is unwanted, but listing 24+ cities is overkill. Needs a decision on whether to special-case timezone codes to a canonical city, limit the list to N cities, or change the output format entirely.
